name: Spec-Code-Test Consistency (SCT)
description: Test-domain extension for Spec Kit: auto-generate a test plan from spec + plan artifacts, derive write-once tests across unit / interface (protocol-agnostic) / e2e (scenario cases only), and gate every change on hard evidence (coverage ≥90%, cases 100% passing, no missing coverage) with a human-reviewable report.
